name: hrow5_cbw_cx-r8b-cl-COMMIT
purpose: r8b (claude-hrow 10-13): r8a 6.0 um M5 no-entry strip inside SRAM vertical edges PLUS real launch decoupling: r7 netlist kept 1,104 macro launch flops but opt_merge folded the un-kept chain pin flops wi/ri into them (5 cells each left), so one flop still drove SRAM wd_in/addr and the forwarding register (FF misses cbe -3.08 at SRAM pins, cbw -20.24 at 13 D pins). keep on wi/ri makes chain forwarding and SRAM launch separate flops (expect ~6,294 flops), no latency change. Pass: DRC 0, TT/FF >= 0, child_lint c+f at M5, hrow_tiles pos PASS / mut FAIL; log CX_HROW created 8 strip 6.0 / removed 8, OT_SPINE done.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_mtp_hrow_cbw u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_hrow_tiles.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/rtt/ot_dsrom_mtp_rstsync.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_link_rtt.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hrow5_cbw_cx/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hrow5_cbw_cx/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hrow5_cbw_cx --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_mtp_hrow_cbw --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
